description: Public Service Commission - Appointed Three  Member Health Service Committee that shall come into force w.e.f. 01.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the appointment of a committee by the Public Service Commission, a body that oversees public sector administration. The content details the establishment, composition, and effective date of the "Health Service Committee" for the Health Service Sector. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically covering public service commission appointments and decisions, which is the definition of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
